{{nihongo|'''Ono Shrine'''|小野神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Musashi Province]].

'''Ono Shrine''' (おのじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Fuchū, Tokyo|ar|فوتشو (طوكيو)|azb|فوچو، توکیو|bg|Фучу|ca|Fuchū (Tòquio)|ce|Футю (Токио)|ceb|Fuchū-shi (distrito sa Hapon, Tōkyō-to)|cs|Fučú (Tokio)|de|Fuchū (Tokio)|el|Φουτσού (Τόκιο)|eo|Fuĉu|es|Fuchū (Tokio)|et|Fuchū|eu|Fuchū|fa|فوچو، توکیو|fi|Fuchū (Tokio)|fr|Fuchū|gl|Fuchū, Tokyo|hy|Ֆուտյու (Տոկիո)|id|Fuchū, Tōkyō|it|Fuchū (Tokyo)|ja|府中市 (東京都)|ko|후추시 (도쿄도)|lt|Fučiū (Tokijas)|ms|Fuchu|mzn|فوچو، توکیو|nl|Fuchu (Tokio)|no|Fuchū|pl|Fuchū (Tokio)|pt|Fuchū (Tóquio)|ro|Fuchū, Tōkyō|ru|Футю (Токио)|sh|Fuchū, Tokijo|simple|Fuchū, Tokyo|sr|Фучу (Токио)|su|Fuchu, Tokyo|sv|Fuchū, Tokyo|szl|Fuchū (Tokjo)|tg|Фучу, Токио|th|ฟูจู (โตเกียว)|tl|Fuchū, Tokyo|tr|Fuchū|tt|Футю (Токио)|uk|Футю (Токіо)|ur|فوچو، ٹوکیو|vi|Fuchū, Tokyo|war|Fuchū, Tokyo|zh|府中市 (東京都)|zh_classical|府中市 (東京都)|zh_min_nan|Hutyû-chhī (Tang-kiaⁿ)|zh_yue|府中市 (東京都)|qid=Q208818|lt=Fuchū}}, {{ill|Tokyo|Q1490|qid=Q1490}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} {{ill|Shikinai Ronsha|ja|論社|qid=Q135022904}}. Its former rank under the {{ill|Q712534|lt=Modern shrine ranking system}} was {{ill|Gō-sha|Q134917316|qid=Q134917316}}. It is also called '''Ono-no-miya'''.

=== Overview ===
It is one of the candidates for the shikinaisha “Ono Shrine” in Tama District, {{ill|Musashi Province|Q907398|qid=Q907398}}, listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932}}. Another candidate is {{ill|Ono Shrine|Q11464224|qid=Q11464224|lt=Ono Shrine}} in {{ill|Tama, Tokyo|Q213263|qid=Q213263}} (for details as a shikinaisha, see {{ill|Ono Shrine|Q11464224|qid=Q11464224}}). Because this shrine is below the {{ill|hake escarpment|Q11275384|qid=Q11275384}}, it is said there came to be two shrines due to relocations caused by flooding of the {{ill|Tama River|Q1063006|qid=Q1063006}}; another view says one is the original shrine and the other a branch.

While Ono Shrine in Tama was protected by the {{ill|Tokugawa shogunate|Q205662|qid=Q205662}} as the {{ill|Ichinomiya|Q1656379|qid=Q1656379}} of Musashi Province, this shrine declined as reverence increased for nearby Musashi provincial {{ill|Sōja shrine|Q1107129|qid=Q1107129}}, Rokusho-no-miya ({{ill|Ōkunitama Shrine|Q611678|qid=Q611678}}).

In {{ill|1873|Q7757|qid=Q7757}} (Meiji 6) it was ranked as gōsha. The shrine burned in a fire in Taishō 15, and the current buildings were rebuilt afterward.

=== Enshrined deities ===
Main deities are the following two.
* {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Ame-no-Shitaharu-no-Mikoto}}
* {{ill|Seoritsu-hime|ja|瀬織津姫|zh|瀨織津姬神|qid=Q13579836|lt=Seoritsuhime-no-Mikoto}}
